name: Set a model's maximum sigma
plain: Gives a copy of the model a different top sigma, by scaling its sigma table, so a scheduler fed from it starts higher or lower. Meant for the scheduler, not the sampler.
math:
m = σ_max_new/σ_max (or |σ_max_new| as a multiplier when negative).
sigmas' = sigmas·m.
